blade_count.quote: The rotor has 22 blades and an aspect ratio of 1.56 (based on average span/root axial chord).

aspect_ratio.quote: an aspect ratio of 1.56 (based on average span/root axial chord).

solidity_hub_tip.quote: The rotor solidity varies from 3.11 at the hub to 1.29 at the tip.

tip_diameters.quote: The inlet and exit tip diameters are 51.4 and 48.5 cm, respectively,

hub_tip_ratios.quote: the inlet and exit hub/tip radius ratios are 0.375 and 0.478, respectively.

hub_fillet_radius.quote: A fillet radius of 1.78 mm is used at the airfoil-hub juncture.

surface_finish_rms.quote: The square root of the mean square of the airfoil surface finish is 0.8 um or better, the airfoil surface tolerance is +-0.04 mm

design_speed.quote: The design rotational speed is 16 043 rpm, which yields a tip speed of 429 m/sec and an inlet tip relative Mach number of 1.38.

design_tip_speed.quote: which yields a tip speed of 429 m/sec

design_inlet_tip_relative_mach.quote: an inlet tip relative Mach number of 1.38.

configuration.value: rotor only; stator removed; no IGV; first-stage rotor of the TP-1493 two-stage fan
configuration.quote: p6: 'It is an undampered low-aspect-ratio design rotor and is the first-stage rotor of a two-stage fan.' p5: 'The fan was designed for axial inflow and did not require an inlet guide vane. The fan was also operated without a stator.'

span_convention.value: spanwise locations measured from the tip
span_convention.quote: (All spanwise locations discussed in this report are measured from the tip.)

blade_geometry_table_I.value: Table I, PDF p22-36: blade surface coordinates on surfaces of revolution at design speed (hot shape), 14 sections x 35 points plus LE/TE circles; NOT transcribed
blade_geometry_table_I.quote: Blade coordinates at the design speed operating condition are given in table I for surfaces of revolution for 14 blade sections. ... The blade surface coordinates are given at 35 points for each blade section.

z_origin.value: Z = 0 at intersection of blade leading edge with hub (flowpath and blade geometry)
z_origin.quote: The origin of all blade geometry Z-coordinates is the intersection of the blade leading edge with the hub.

blade_section_14.value: section 14 lies outside the physical blade tip; actual tip = section 14 minus 1.0 mm normal to shroud
blade_section_14.quote: Blade section 14 lies outside the physical blade tip. The R,Z-location of the actual tip of the blade under design speed operating conditions can be obtained by subtracting 1.0 mm from blade section 14 in a direction which is normal to the annulus shroud contour.

hot_shape_restagger.value: NASTRAN-derived hot geometry corrected by 1.4 deg restagger toward closed at planar section 25.4 cm along stacking axis from centerline, faired to 0 deg at 20.32 cm
hot_shape_restagger.quote: This correction amounts to a 1.4 deg restagger toward the closed position at the planar manufacturing section located 25.4 cm along the stacking axis from the rotor centerline. This correction is faired to 0 deg at the planar manufacturing section located 20.32 cm along the stacking axis from the rotor centerline,
